title: YUMEGIK
tagline: For you in the future, and for you in the present who are contemplating whether or not to process memories such as the pictures you drew and the photos you took in the past. I suggest using a and b to store those memories instead.
description:
hi! This project is 'YUMEGIK'.

'YUMEGIK' was born from the combination of 'ゆめ (yume)', which means dream in Japanese, and 'MEGIK', a combination of 'MAGIC' and 'KID'.

I like to draw.
Over 20 years since I was 5 years old, I still love to draw.
Even when I'm just studying in general, even when I stop developing for a while, even after entering web3, I continue to draw, at least scribbling.

What I feel while painting is that I can't find more of the pictures I've painted before (as far as I can remember).
Also, while moving this time, I had no choice but to leave most of the paintings I had when I was very young due to space constraints.

Also, you can meet many people while drawing, and I have often seen that the number of people who draw as a hobby decreases as they get older.
Rather, it is assumed that young students, usually middle school students, draw a lot of pictures.
At that point, they tend to throw away their paintings simply because they are ashamed. Unfortunately, it is a personal choice, but soon it comes to the desire to see the painting again later. with regret.

Based on my experience like this, I propose an idea to keep the paintings/photos I have drawn. Wouldn't that be possible enough in web3?

Although we have proceeded with the idea of a picture for now, it would be nice to come up with a dapp that can expand to a wider range, such as text and 3d models, to keep memories and previous dreams intact in various ways.

good luck everyone!
